title: GTA6 Hopes: What Rockstar Should Borrow From GTA 4
description: Discover why an IGN editor returning to GTA 4 for the first time since 2008 hopes GTA 6 borrows key elements from the classic open-world title.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Returning to Liberty City: The Enduring Appeal of GTA 4

As anticipation builds for the release of Grand Theft Auto 6, gamers and industry critics alike are eagerly speculating about what design choices and features Rockstar Games will bring to the upcoming title. Recently, an editor at IGN shared their experience of playing Grand Theft Auto 4 for the first time since its original release back in 2008, expressing a strong desire for GTA 6 to borrow heavily from its predecessor.

Ever since it launched in 2008, GTA 4 has maintained a dedicated following thanks to its advanced physics engine, gritty atmosphere, and meticulous attention to detail. While subsequent entries like GTA 5 achieved massive commercial success and expanded the series' scope, many veteran players still hold a deep appreciation for the grounded realism found in Liberty City. This recent retrospective by IGN brings those classic elements back into the spotlight.

## What Could GTA 6 Learn From The Past?

While Rockstar has kept official details regarding GTA 6 tightly under wraps, the gaming community continues to discuss which foundational elements might make a comeback. The intricate physics, realistic pedestrian behavior, and immersive environmental storytelling of GTA 4 are often cited as benchmarks that fans hope to see modernized in the next chapter.

Industry analysis suggests that combining the sprawling scale of modern open-world design with the granular detail of past titles could result in an unprecedented level of immersion for players stepping into the new iteration of Vice City.

## Editor's Take

Revisiting older titles often offers a fresh perspective on game design. GTA 4 remains a landmark title for its atmospheric depth and physics. Incorporating those foundational lessons into GTA 6 could help bridge the gap between scale and immersion, delivering an unforgettable experience for both new and veteran players.
